notes.title: Huntsman joins the PC Gaming Show: Tokyo Direct
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome, new Atherton Labs employee, to the best, and maybe last, job you’ll ever have. As the world leader in bioengineering pharmaceuticals, Atherton Labs prides itself in finding cutting edge solutions to all of life’s problems. Much of our research is inspired by nature itself, including our recent advances in toxicology from the arachnid department. 
[/p][p]As part of your onboarding process with Atherton Labs, we have created a training video to demonstrate what you can expect from life at our company. We’re incredibly excited to confirm that you are the first employee to ever see this new video, in partnership with PC Gaming Show: Tokyo Direct. We look forward to seeing you all on your first day, when we will unveil this new video and share many exciting updates, on Sunday 28th September, 9am PST / 12pm EST / 5pm GMT / 6pm CEST.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681192/76c7a62cc76f13dcc0c1620d32c826a255c83ab0.png"][/img][/p][p]PC Gaming Show: [url="https://www.pcgamingshow.com/"]https://www.pcgamingshow.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Nku7QGXqxD"]https://discord.gg/Nku7QGXqxD[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/huntsman_gameofficial/"]https://www.instagram.com/huntsman_gameofficial/[/url][/p][p]X: [url="https://x.com/FEARtheHuntsman"]https://x.com/FEARtheHuntsman[/url][/p][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthehuntsman"]https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthehuntsman[/url][/p][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@TenImagePublishing"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Website: [url="https://www.tenimagepublishing.com/huntsman"]www.tenimagepublishing.com/huntsman[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]

notes.title: Welcome to Huntsman
notes.notes: [p]Welcome friends, to the first of many updates about the mysteries within Atherton Labs, the setting for our fear-inducing tale of webbed wonder; Huntsman. [/p][p][/p][p]Some of you may be aware of the game from our breakout success on Itch, where our demo exploded and was covered by major content creators, which we are still blown away by. But however you found us, we want to share that we’re now in full production on the game with an exciting journey ahead of us, and we’re ready to shout about Huntsman, starting with a huge thank you to our community.[/p][p][/p][p]So what is Huntsman? It’s billed as ‘a survival horror that will immerse you in the creeping dread and crawling terror of arachnophobia’ and by this we mean ‘a massive spider will chase you around a shadowy series of locations until you are too afraid to sleep with the lights off’. It’s got thrills, chills, spills and spider(s)...but more on that later. We’d love for you to wishlist and follow the game, join in with the discussion on any of the channels below and, best of all, tell your friends about us. [/p][p][/p][p]Huntsman is a labour of love made by a single developer, and there’s a lot more of the game to show over the coming months. Spread the word all over the web and if you want to stay in direct contact with us, our social links are below, and discord is always the recommendation.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/Nku7QGXqxD"]https://discord.gg/Nku7QGXqxD[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/huntsman_gameofficial/"]https://www.instagram.com/huntsman_gameofficial/[/url][/p][p]X: [url="https://x.com/FEARtheHuntsman"]https://x.com/FEARtheHuntsman[/url][/p][p]TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthehuntsman"]https://www.tiktok.com/@fearthehuntsman[/url][/p][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@TenImagePublishing"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Website: [url="https://www.tenimagepublishing.com/huntsman"]www.tenimagepublishing.com/huntsman[/url][/p]
